data.notes: Only tightly verified July 2026 Tel Aviv scene listings were included; recurring local nights without a confirmed July source were omitted.

events.title: Keinemusik | 23 July Israel
events.summary: Zygo lists Keinemusik for a Tel Aviv-Yafo event on July 23, 2026. The Berlin-rooted collective is billed with its signature blend of house, techno and afro-inspired rhythms.

events.title: Keinemusik — Tel Aviv
events.summary: Berlin collective Keinemusik brings its house, techno and afro-inspired sound to Tel Aviv for a large-format day-into-evening event, confirmed on Zygo for 23 July 2026.

events.title: Israel Philharmonic: Lahav Shani & Rudolf Buchbinder
events.summary: The Israel Philharmonic lists Tel Aviv performances on July 1 and July 3 with Lahav Shani conducting and directing, Rudolf Buchbinder as pianist, and vocal soloists Matthias Goerne and Dorottya Lang. The program includes Brahms and Bartók's semi-staged Bluebeard's Castle.

events.title: Israel Philharmonic: Lahav Shani & Giorgi Gigashvili
events.summary: The Israel Philharmonic lists Tel Aviv performances on July 16, July 18 and July 20 with Lahav Shani conducting and Giorgi Gigashvili as pianist. The program includes R. Strauss's Don Juan, Ravel's Piano Concerto and Schubert's Symphony No. 9.

events.title: 5 Years <120 — Richard Sen at Hameretz2
events.summary: The <120 crew marks five years with a late-night Hameretz2 party featuring Richard Sen, NDV and LtDan, leaning into slower psychedelic, cosmic, dub, acid and electronic house/techno-adjacent territory.

events.title: Israel Philharmonic Jeans Concert: Lahav Shani presents Bluebeard's Castle
events.summary: A one-night Israel Philharmonic Jeans Concert with Lahav Shani as conductor, director and presenter. The program is Bartók's Bluebeard's Castle in semi-staged form with Matthias Goerne and Dorottya Lang.

events.title: Shazamat at Barby
events.summary: Shazamat are listed for a July 4 show at Barby in Tel Aviv-Yafo. The event page categorizes the act as hip-hop/rap and points to tickets via Bandsintown/Shazam.

events.title: Shalosh at Shablul Jazz
events.summary: Songkick lists Israeli jazz trio Shalosh for a July 20 concert at Shablul Jazz in Tel Aviv-Jaffa. This is a strong local jazz pick at one of the city's dedicated jazz rooms.

events.title: Rudolf Buchbinder and the IPO's Musicians in a Chamber Concert
events.summary: Rudolf Buchbinder joins Israel Philharmonic musicians for a chamber program at Zucker Hall. The listed repertoire includes Mendelssohn, Viktor Ullmann and Dvořák's Piano Quintet No. 2.

events.title: Israel Philharmonic for Kids: Peter and the Wolf
events.summary: The Israel Philharmonic lists two Tel Aviv Saturday-morning performances of Peter and the Wolf on July 4, conducted by Nitai Rach with actor Gabriel Hadar among the listed artists. This is a family-oriented Philharmonic for Kids program.
